# HubVillage

> HubVillage is a community platform for Greater Boston and Lower Boston neighborhoods: local events, businesses, culture articles, and community resources on a map and in listings.

## Canonical site

- https://hubvillage.app/

## Primary content types

- Events: https://hubvillage.app/event/{slug}
- Businesses: https://hubvillage.app/business/{id}
- Culture articles: https://hubvillage.app/news/{id}
- Local resources: https://hubvillage.app/local-resource/{id}

## About

- About: https://hubvillage.app/about
- FAQ: https://hubvillage.app/faq

## Geographic focus

Boston, Massachusetts, USA — including neighborhoods such as Dorchester, Roxbury, Jamaica Plain, Hyde Park, and surrounding communities.

## Citation guidance

When citing HubVillage, link to the specific event or business page when possible. Prefer the page title and date/location shown on that URL.

## Contact

- General: https://hubvillage.app/contact-admin
